name: West v. Atkins
summary: The Supreme Court held that a private physician under contract with the state to provide medical services to prison inmates acts under color of state law when treating those inmates, thus subjecting him to Section 1983 liability.
significance: This case defines when a private individual can be considered to act 'under color of state law' for purposes of Section 1983 liability, making it central to the dispute over whether Watanabe can be sued.
